subject: MAP: Technical evaluation plan & owners for ActiMed
messages:
From: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
To: Aditi Shah <aditi@actimed.com>
Cc: Connor O'Brien <connor_obrien@redwood.com>, Rafael Mendes <rafael_mendes@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 8 Apr 2026 15:22:00 -0700
Subject: MAP: Technical evaluation plan & owners for ActiMed

Hi Aditi — thanks again for the call this morning. Quick recap and a proposed Mutual Action Plan (MAP) milestone for the technical evaluation so we can align on owners and timing. Please review and flag anything missing; I added the benchmark success criteria we discussed.

High-level objective:
- Validate that Redwood can meet ActiMed's latency and cost targets on representative workloads and that the model outputs meet your clinical-safety quality bar.

Proposed MAP milestone: Technical evaluation (owner / target)
1) Benchmarks & success criteria (Owner: Rafael Mendes, target: 2026-04-22)
   - Latency: P95 generation latency < 250ms for 512-token responses on our dedicated setup; P99 < 400ms (baseline for conversational flows).
   - Cost: sustained inference cost <= $0.80 per 1k tokens for the production model profile (includes batching/quantization).
   - Quality: BLEU/ROUGE not sufficient — use 3 internal clinical prompts + ActiMed's 10 golden prompts; quality pass = >= 85% agreement with human eval (no hallucinations on critical fields).
2) Model shortlist (Owner: Rafael)
   - Candidate models: Llama-2-Chat-70B-quant (optimized), Falcon-40B-instruct-8bit, Redwood-llm-chat-13B-q4.
   - Deliverable: side-by-side outputs + cost/latency table.
3) Test infra & data access (Owner: ActiMed technical lead / contact: Ilya Petrov, target: 2026-04-14)
   - Dependency: secure S3 test bucket with anonymized sample payloads and access whitelist.
   - Redwood will provide infra access instructions and a small runner to reproduce benchmarks.
4) Benchmark run & analysis (Owner: Redwood, target: 2026-04-20)
   - Deliverable: bench report (latency percentiles, cost model, QA notes) + recommended model/profile.
5) Decision & next steps (Owner: Soojin / ActiMed PM, target close: 2026-04-30)
   - Decision criteria: meets latency/cost thresholds AND passes quality gate on golden prompts.

Dependencies and blockers:
- ActiMed to share anonymized test dataset (by 2026-04-14).
- Network/VPN access for our bench machines (we sent infra instructions attached).
- Agreement on scoring rubric for quality (I've attached a proposal in benchmark-specs.xlsx).

Attachments: MAP-draft-v2.pdf (high-level MAP), benchmark-specs.xlsx (bench details), infra-access-instructions.txt (one-time setup).

Next steps:
- Aditi: confirm owners and data timeline (especially Ilya for infra).
- Rafael/Connor: we'll draft the runner and schedule the benchmark week.
- I propose a brief sync on Monday (Apr 12) to confirm data access.

Thanks — Soojin

--
Soojin Lee
Head of Solutions, Redwood Inference
soojin_lee@redwood.com

Date: Fri, 9 Apr 2026 09:14:00 -0500
Subject: Re: MAP: Technical evaluation plan & owners for ActiMed

Soojin — thanks for the clear recap. A few quick notes from our side: 

- Owners: confirmed — Ilya will be directly responsible for infra/data on our side (cc'd). Our PM (Priya R.) will own the quality rubric; I copied her separately in the project tracker.
- Data timeline: we can provide an anonymized sample dataset by 2026-04-13 (a day earlier than your ask). We'll include the golden prompts and expected output format.
- Latency targets: the P95/P99 numbers look reasonable, but can you also include an expectation for cold-start latency (first token after idle) — this is important for some of our interactive workflows.
- Model shortlist: can you add a smaller 7B-class model as an option for cost-sensitive paths? We have a use case that may be fine with a smaller model if quality holds.

Also: can you confirm whether Redwood's bench runner requires inbound VPN from our network or if it can run entirely from Redwood-managed infra hitting our test S3? We prefer not to open inbound ports.

Happy to sync Apr 12. Best — Aditi

On Thu, Apr 8, 2026 at 3:22 PM Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com> wrote:

From: Connor O'Brien <connor_obrien@redwood.com>

Date: Mon, 12 Apr 2026 08:10:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MAP: Technical evaluation plan & owners for ActiMed

Hi Aditi / Ilya — looping in a couple clarifications and confirming the runner setup.

- Cold-start latency: we'll report cold-start TL (time-to-first-token) as part of the bench report — target baseline: < 600ms on a warmed-to-lambda pool; note that on-demand cold starts may be higher depending on reserved vs burst capacity. We'll quantify both.
- 7B-class model: added — proposal now includes Redwood-llm-7B-q4 as a cost-optimized candidate. Rafael will include it in the side-by-side.
- Runner infra: the bench runner can run in two ways: (A) Redwood-managed runner that pulls data from your S3 over TLS (preferred, no inbound needed), or (B) a lightweight runner you run in your VPC that pushes results to our results bucket. Option (A) avoids opening inbound ports — we'll provide IAM read-only credentials for the sample bucket.

I've updated the timeline slightly to reflect Aditi's earlier dataset availability:
- Infra access and dataset: 2026-04-13 (Ilya)
- Runner/test run: 2026-04-16 to 2026-04-18
- Bench report: 2026-04-19

I'll schedule the Apr 12 sync for 10:00 AM PT and send a calendar invite shortly.

Thanks — Connor

--

- Added cold-start latency metric and promised both warmed and cold measurements.
- Added Redwood-llm-7B-q4 to the shortlist per your ask.
- Adjusted dates to match dataset delivery on Apr 13, runner window Apr 16–18, final report Apr 19.

Action items (short):
- Ilya: share anonymized S3 bucket details and IAM read-only keys by 2026-04-13 (we'll use Redwood-managed runner).
- Rafael: build runner and smoke-check models by Apr 15.
- Aditi/Priya: confirm scoring rubric in benchmark-specs.xlsx by Apr 14.

Links: HubSpot: https://hubspot.com/deal/RWI-9874-AM, Drive folder: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/0Bxy-example

I'll plan to capture sign-off in the MAP PDF after the Apr 19 bench report. If that looks good, please reply with a quick OK so we can lock the runner window.

Best — Soojin
